# Test fixtures

Every fixture here is **inert**: domains end in `.invalid` (guaranteed never to
resolve), addresses are private, and nothing is marked executable. They contain
the *patterns* malicious add-ons use so the scanner can be tested against them.

Some antivirus products flag text that merely contains such patterns (for example
the reverse-shell one-liner). If yours does, exclude this folder.

Fixtures that need binary content (bytecode, archives, invisible Unicode,
whitespace inflation) are generated by the tests instead of committed, see
`internal/scan/bypass_test.go`.
